assets.prompt: Photorealistic overhead editorial photograph of a thoughtfully prepared everyday fitness meal on a pale stone counter: a warm ivory ceramic plate of cooked sliced chicken breast, white rice, avocado and colorful vegetables, with a bowl of Greek yogurt and blueberries nearby.
